youtube.title: He Wouldn't Say It | Polycarp, 86, Before Rome #shorts
youtube.text:
The true story of Polycarp of Smyrna. Rome gave the old pastor an easy way out: swear by Caesar, curse Christ, and go home. He wouldn't say it.

Full story: https://youtu.be/Z8OuFTS-pTg

From the Martyrdom of Polycarp, the letter the church in Smyrna wrote after his death, around AD 155.

Type amen, and send this to a friend who needs it.

#shorts #polycarp #christianmartyrs #churchhistory #faith
